name: Mizuki Hitomi
source: She made acquaintance with the protagonist by accident. She is a maid in the household of one of the two key families who rule over the town. She is very weak and can not protect herself from dangers. However, she can take very good care of others. She often worries if her behaviors may bring up trouble to others.
